condition: Passing a TimeSeriesSplit as cv to StackingRegressor/StackingClassifier raises "ValueError: cross_val_predict only works for partitions" on fit, because the splitter does not put every sample in a test set.
workaround: Use a CV strategy that puts every sample in exactly one test fold (for example KFold), or build the stacking by hand with time-ordered out-of-fold predictions.
